sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Machine Gun Gemling stacks crossbow gem quality so Armour Piercing Rounds shreds packs and High Velocity Rounds handles bosses. Gem Studded rewards a balanced support-colour spread, turning 'quality' into real damage and reload economy.
This is a verification-first guide. Quality stacking, Armour Break confirmation and the reload cycle are described from current creator guides; the craft-risk note is the actionable core.

sections.title: Pros and Cons
pros: Extremely fast screen clear with Armour Piercing Rounds.
Quality stacking is a clear, repeatable scaling path.
Mobile and reload-based; feels good while moving.
Gemling attribute economy supports the colours.
cons: Crossbow crafting can waste currency if rushed.
Armour Break must be confirmed, not assumed.
One-button clear is not one-button bossing.
Support colour balance affects Gem Studded tiers.

sections.title: Is This Build Right For You?
paragraphs: Pick Machine Gun Gemling if you want a fast crossbow mapper and you are comfortable with reload timing and a modest crafting step. It is a strong league starter that scales into endgame.
If you hate crafting, a pre-rolled crossbow works, but the build's ceiling comes from quality. Accept some crafting or skip the luxury tier.

steps.label: Levels 1-30 - Crossbow leveling
body: Level with a basic crossbow skill (e.g. a default round). Focus on life and resistances; quality stacking is not online yet.

steps.label: Levels 31-55 - APR setup
body: Switch to Armour Piercing Rounds for clear and add the reload/quality supports. Cap resistances before pushing damage.

steps.label: Levels 56+ - Quality stack
body: Stack gem quality on the crossbow and supports. Add High Velocity Rounds for bossing on Weapon Set 2.

steps.label: Waystones - Endgame
body: Balance support colours for Gem Studded tiers, refine the crossbow craft, then push maps.

whyUse: Shreds packs once quality and pierce line up.

mappingBossingDiff: Bossing on Set 2; not the clear skill.

recommendations: The headline craft: quality on the crossbow and supports drives the build. Desecrate/boost only on an endgame base you will keep; do not waste currency on a transition weapon.
Life and resistances first; the crossbow is where the craft budget goes.
Attribute requirements for the support colours, life and a bit of reload speed. Gemling's attribute economy helps here.
Reload speed, physical damage, life. Luxury only after the core is solved.

steps.label: Starter -> Functional
body: Cap resistances, secure life, run a basic crossbow. Quality stacking starts once APR is online.

steps.label: Functional -> Endgame
body: Stack quality, add High Velocity Rounds for bosses, balance support colours.

steps.label: Endgame -> Luxury
body: Refine the crossbow craft and jewels only after T15 is comfortable.

sections.title: Crossbow Base
paragraphs: Pick a crossbow base you will keep before investing currency. A transition weapon is not worth a deep craft; buy a better base instead of forcing rolls on a throwaway.

sections.title: Quality Stacking
paragraphs: Crossbow and support gem quality feed the damage and reload economy. Advanced Thaumaturgy amplifies quality's effect, so the build rewards deliberate quality investment over raw item level.

sections.title: Armour Break Confirmation
paragraphs: Armour Piercing Rounds relies on Armour Break being applied. Confirm the break is active (the debuff is present) before assuming your pierce is working; a missing break means far lower damage.

sections.title: Reload Cycle
paragraphs: Reload and Emergency Reload keep you firing while moving. The cycle is: fire through the magazine, reload on motion, use Emergency Reload only when caught. Treat reload as a movement tool, not a downtime penalty.

sections.title: Mapping Rotation
paragraphs: For normal packs: Armour Piercing Rounds with Chain, keep moving and reload on the go. The clear is the gimmick; enjoy the speed but watch for rares.

sections.title: Rare Rotation
paragraphs: For rares: confirm Armour Break, then focus fire. Use a defensive roll if the rare is dangerous; do not over-extend into a deadly modifier.

sections.title: Boss Rotation
paragraphs: For bosses: swap to Weapon Set 2 (High Velocity Rounds), confirm Armour Break, then the boss loop. Verify the loop in the current client before treating the written order as final, and reload during movement windows.

sections.title: Gemling Legionnaire Ascendancy
paragraphs: Gemling Legionnaire's attribute economy supports the support-colour spread that Gem Studded wants, and the ascendancy's gem bonuses compound with quality stacking. It is the natural home for this crossbow fantasy.

sections.title: Passive Tree Approach
paragraphs: Start with life, resistances and crossbow nodes, then specialize toward quality, reload and armour break as gear allows. The tree is read against your support colours, not copied wholesale.

sections.title: Crossbow Craft Decision
paragraphs: Do not craft on a transition weapon; the currency is wasted. On an endgame base with a key prefix, use an Omen to protect it; with an already-high skill roll, simulate before re-rolling. Craft only when you will keep the base.

sections.title: Budget Variants
paragraphs: Starter uses a bought or dropped crossbow with basic quality. Functional Endgame stacks quality and balances colours. Luxury is a fully crafted crossbow and perfect jewels - do not treat the crafted ceiling as your default target.

sections.title: Defensive Layers
paragraphs: Life plus resistances is the baseline; the mobile reload playstyle avoids many hits. Do not drop defenses for more quality - at high speed you still take hits, so the pool must be real.

sections.title: Community Voices

entries.label: Reddit - reload questions
entries.statement: Players ask when to reload. The consensus is reload during movement, save Emergency Reload for being caught.

entries.label: Forum - APR damage
entries.statement: Common complaint: low damage traced to Armour Break not being applied. Confirm the debuff before assuming the build is weak.

entries.label: Guide comments - craft
entries.statement: Players warn that crafting on a transition crossbow wastes currency; buy a better base instead.

sections.note: Short paraphrases of common community questions and concerns, edited for clarity. Not verbatim quotes.

items.question: Why is Armour Piercing Rounds good for clear?
answer: It shreds armour and chains through packs once quality and Armour Break line up; the clear is fast and screen-wide.

items.question: What does Advanced Thaumaturgy do?
answer: It amplifies the effect of gem quality, which is why quality stacking is the build's core scaling path.

items.question: Is one-button clear the same as one-button bossing?
answer: No. Mapping uses Armour Piercing Rounds; bosses use High Velocity Rounds on Set 2 with a confirmed Armour Break loop.

items.question: Should I craft on my first crossbow?
answer: No. Craft only on an endgame base you will keep; a transition weapon is not worth the currency.

checks: First confirm Armour Break is applied; a missing break explains most 'weak' reports. Then check quality and support colours.

problems.symptom: Running out of uptime / reload panic
checks: Reload during movement windows; reserve Emergency Reload for being caught. Add reload speed on rings/quiver.
